notes.zh:
### v0.8.0

- 壁纸与毛玻璃：支持上传/设置主页背景图，模糊、遮罩浓度、透明度可调；侧边栏、顶栏、视图弹窗统一玻璃质感
- 浮动侧边栏：侧边栏改为圆角卡片悬浮于壁纸之上，收起/展开按钮移入侧边栏内部（方向图标），窄屏点图标栏开抽屉
- 页面弹窗化：设置与各资源页（skills/tools/agents/mcp/channels/计划）改为居中弹窗，侧边栏常驻；弹窗内滚动条隐藏
- 顶栏精简：logo/版本号/更新按钮不随侧边栏折叠消失；搜索入口移回侧边栏
- 工作区：新增「新建文件夹…」（POST /api/workspaces/mkdir），项目选择条与路径操作体验优化
- 设置分区收敛：外观-主页背景并入设置；删除返回对话等冗余入口

### v0.7.1

- 模型配置页上下文窗口支持手动保存官方规格（如 agnes-3.0-flash 512K）：白名单改为 1024..10000000 范围校验
- 手动修改上下文窗口时弹出确认框（显示覆盖前后值）
- 设置-概览心跳专用 LLM 下拉文字居中
- 版本更新提示改走 GitHub Releases：发版即触发客户端红点+弹窗，同源 updater.json 兜底

### v0.7.0

- 全量代码审查修复批次（28 处缺陷：2 Critical / 8 High / 18 Medium-Low）：
- 修复会话助手回复因长度推算错误而丢失的 Critical 缺陷（有记忆工作区首轮触发并复合恶化）
- 修复 MCP preset 变更后热重载完全失效（协程未被 await）
- SSRF 防护补齐 IPv6 未指定地址/NAT64/IPv4 兼容网段与 exec 命令行绕过形态
- 恢复两个静默失效配置：单轮墙钟超时（maxTurnWallTimeS）与 LLM 步骤验收器（enableStepVerifier）；周期性反思恢复触发
- 心跳任务不再污染并发用户回合（per-turn ContextVar 覆盖）
- 出站派发增加单连接发送超时，慢客户端不再冻结整个网关；入站消费热循环快速失败守卫
- 记忆 append_history 跨进程 FileLock、原子写补父目录 fsync、损坏会话修复路径自身崩溃等持久化加固

### v0.6.0

- 项目选择："打开本地文件夹"由网关弹出系统原生目录选择框（浏览器环境此前无法选本机路径），菜单精简为默认工作区 + 打开本地文件夹
- 窄视口布局：侧边栏常驻为图标栏而非隐藏，顶栏版本徽章自动隐藏避免与按钮重叠
- WebUI 微信式截图捕获与输入区选择器打磨

### v0.5.0

- 记忆系统升级：常驻画像、反思写入、溢出自清理
- Provider 并发限流重试加入抖动，避免齐步重试
- WebUI 截图捕获入口
notes.en:
### v0.8.0

- Wallpaper & glass: set a home background image (upload/URL) with blur, dim, and opacity controls; sidebar, top bar, and view dialogs share one glass treatment
- Floating sidebar: rounded card floating over the wallpaper; collapse/expand control moved into the sidebar (direction chevrons); narrow viewports open the drawer from the rail
- Pages as dialogs: Settings and resource views (skills/tools/agents/mcp/channels/cron) open as centered modals with the main sidebar kept; scrollbar hidden inside dialogs
- Top bar: logo, version badge, and update button no longer disappear when the sidebar collapses; search returns to the sidebar
- Workspace: new "New folder…" action (POST /api/workspaces/mkdir) and cleaner project path controls
- Settings consolidation: appearance/home wallpaper merged into Settings; removed redundant back-to-chat entry points

### v0.7.1

- Model settings page now accepts manual context-window values matching official specs (e.g. agnes-3.0-flash 512K): allowlist replaced with 1024..10000000 range check
- Confirm dialog before overwriting the context window (shows old vs new value)
- Heartbeat LLM dropdown text centered in Settings Overview
- Update check now follows GitHub Releases (release triggers badge+modal), same-origin updater.json as fallback

### v0.7.0

- Full code-review remediation batch (28 defects: 2 Critical / 8 High / 18 Medium-Low):
- Critical fix: assistant replies silently lost from a save-skip length miscalculation (triggered on the first turn of any workspace with memory, compounding afterwards)
- Critical fix: MCP hot-reload after preset changes never ran (coroutine created but never awaited)
- SSRF hardening: IPv6 unspecified/NAT64/IPv4-compatible ranges and exec command-line bypass forms now blocked
- Revived two silently-dead settings: per-turn wall-time timeout (maxTurnWallTimeS) and the LLM step verifier (enableStepVerifier); periodic reflection now fires
- Heartbeat no longer mutates shared state seen by concurrent user turns (per-turn ContextVar overrides)
- Outbound dispatch gained a per-connection send timeout so a slow client can no longer freeze the gateway; inbound consume hot-loop now fails fast
- Persistence hardening: cross-process FileLock for memory append_history, parent-dir fsync after atomic writes, and a crash fix in the corrupted-session repair path
